cohort: 2474 women with one previous cesarean section, alive singleton fetus in cephalic presentation ≥ 37 weeks gestation
finding: No association was found between abnormal pelvic dimension at pelvimetry and severe neonatal morbidity after TOLAC.
mod_finding: This study found no association between abnormal pelvic dimension at pelvimetry and neonatal morbidity after trial of labor after cesarean.
